t: Zinc and blue-passivated and case-hardened. Tri-Lock threadform and shank incorporate the benefits of a single coarse thread with a twin thread start. Spiral point, part thread and under-head ribs for self-countersinking. Flush, neat fix will not work loose, prevents squeaky boards. No pilot hole necessary. Ideal for all flooring such as softwood, fibreboard and hardwood.
b: TS Thread System Offers a Single & Twin Thread in One, Gripping Fast with a Firm Fix
